_comment: Detection model registry (ADR-024). Every model the workers may load: exact source, pinned revision, SHA-256 of every weight file, licence of code and weights, training data and obligations. A model not listed here, or a file whose hash differs, is never loaded. Fetch with tools/models/fetch_models.py; evaluate with tools/models/benchmark_detector.py.

models.code_license: Apache-2.0 (Hugging Face transformers 4.49.0 RTDetrV2ForObjectDetection; reference implementation lyuwenyu/RT-DETR Apache-2.0)
models.training_data: COCO 2017 (annotations CC BY 4.0; images are Flickr photos under their owners' licences per the COCO terms of use)
models.obligations: Apache-2.0: keep the licence and NOTICE, state changes. COCO: attribution for the annotations. Commercial use of weights trained on COCO images: open legal question for counsel (LICENSE_REGISTER section 4).

models.code_license: Not used at run time. The weights are converted once to an OpenVINO model with the HRNet architecture (tools/models/third_party/hrnet_cls.py, Copyright (c) Microsoft, MIT). PnLCalib's own code (GPL-2.0-or-later) is neither copied nor shipped; keypoint decoding and camera fitting are our own (vie_worker/pitch_auto.py).
models.training_data: SoccerNet-Calibration (broadcast football), per the authors under a research agreement that has since expired; the authors state the weights contain no footage and carry no further restrictions.
models.obligations: CC BY 4.0: attribution (the citation above) in the app's About/licences and in the docs; indicate if the weights were modified (converted to OpenVINO IR, not retrained). Counsel: confirm the authors' statement on the expired SoccerNet research agreement before commercial release (LICENSE_REGISTER).
models.status: EVALUATION — automatic pitch calibration (ADR-036): on the owner's match 12 of 13 calibrated main-camera frames correct by eye, no studio/graphics/close-up frame calibrated

_device_comment: Measured 2026-10-27 (release-evidence/model-benchmarks/20261027-devices): OpenVINO 2025.3 on the Intel Arc iGPU at FP32 gives the same detections as PyTorch (100% at IoU 0.9, ball 42/42) at 2.3x the speed; FP16 drops ~1% of people (rejected); the NPU does not compile RT-DETRv2 (driver error). A machine without a usable GPU falls back to the CPU automatically.
